title: A Work Will Be Shown: Artist's Invitations and Announcements 1960-2025

description.main: A compilation of exhibition announcement cards and invitations that the Italian artist Maurizio Nannucci has collected since the 1960s, sorted into twelve thematic groups. Essays by Gabriele Detterer and Emanuele De Donno accompany the cards.
description.extended:
A pocket-sized anthology of the printed cards artists send to announce their shows, edited by Maurizio Nannucci from the collection he has gathered since the 1960s.

The book reproduces invitations and announcements in twelve thematic categories, among them "Welcome to the Opening," "Show A Performance" and "Words Drawings and Diagrams." The cards use images, text, photography, typography, colour and a range of papers, and many came to Nannucci from friends, colleagues, galleries and museums, so the sequence also traces a network of exchanges between artists. The 360-page paperback measures 10.5 x 18 cm and is printed in four colours plus a fluorescent pantone, with essays by Gabriele Detterer and Emanuele De Donno. It was published by Viaindustriae of Foligno, with Zona Archives and the COLLi publishing platform credited in some listings.

Nannucci, born in 1939, is an Italian artist, and here he works as collector and editor of other artists' mail rather than as the author of the cards.

notes: The cover reads 1960-2025; several retailers list the same ISBN with the title ending 1960-2020. Page counts vary by source (352, 359, 360). Language is listed as English by the publisher platform and English and Italian by one library catalogue. Publication date 2025 per a library record; one Italian seller lists 2026. The publisher link goes to the COLLi publishing platform page; COLLi co-published the book. Identified from a spine photograph; edition not checked against the copy.
